entries.description: Four lesbian women living on 17 secluded acres in northern California with a small cabin, looking for other lesbian separatists to join them, build sleeping structures, and help with land payments; also welcoming visiting lesbian women and hoping lesbian women will buy adjacent land.
entries.raw_text: FOUR WOMEN living on 17 secluded acres in northern California are looking for other lesbian separatists to join them. There's a small cabin but women interested in joining them need to build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments. They are hoping that dykes will buy the land adjacent to them that is for sale for $17,000 ($3,400 down). Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit. Contact Joanie, 3100 Ridgewood Rd., Willits, CA, 95490 - Phone 707 459-5776.
entries.notes: Community name taken from capitalized opening words "FOUR WOMEN". Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because four women live on the land and are recruiting others to join and share payments ("FOUR WOMEN living on 17 secluded acres... looking for other lesbian separatists to join them... help with land payments"). Land address copied from street mailing address ("3100 Ridgewood Rd., Willits, CA, 95490") where the residents live. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ("looking for other lesbian separatists to join them", "Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit"). Focus: Lesbian separatism ("other lesbian separatists").

entries.description: 160 acres 25 miles southeast of Tucson, AZ, bought by one woman for any woman and children to rent an A-frame or camp on a nightly or monthly basis, seeking donations in exchange for future camping nights.
entries.raw_text: NOURISHING SPACE FOR WOMEN is located on 160 acres 25 miles southeast of Tucson that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested. There is space for women and children to rent (there is an A-frame and plenty of land to camp on) on a nightly or monthly basis. They need a lot of financial support so for every $2 a woman donates, she is entitled to one free night of camping available any time in her life. In return for a donation they will send information and directions. Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11, Vail, AZ, 85641.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is land "that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested". Mailing address is a PO Box, so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are blank; land_state is AZ from "25 miles southeast of Tucson" and Vail, AZ. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ("any woman interested", "space for women"), Girl children and Boy children ("and children").

entries.description: A group of women squatting on a farm in Ashfield, Massachusetts, who have been told to leave and are seeking financial support and women (no men) to stay with them indefinitely for the action.
entries.raw_text: ASHFIELD FARM WOMEN are "squatting" on a farm in Massachusetts. They have been told to leave but they are hanging on. They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them indefinitely for this action; also financial support. Sorry we don't have all the information about this, but write to the Ashfield Farm Women, Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because a group of women are living together on the farm and recruiting others to stay with them ("ASHFIELD FARM WOMEN are 'squatting' on a farm... They need women to stay with them indefinitely"). Land address copied from road mailing address ("Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330"). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ("They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them").

entries.description: A feminist country retreat in Grants Pass, OR, run by a collective of five resident women who open their house for workshops and discussion groups for women on a sliding scale, with negotiable child care.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE is a feminist country retreat. It is run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops to women seeking more about themselves and their lives. They say, "we feel that living with each other in the country has helped us to become stronger, healthier, more centered, and more creative. Some of the things we have been dealing with are our feminist politics, our sexuality and our own creativity. We know that we need contact with other women and we also need to find a way to survive economically in the country. Womanshare is our way of doing this." Fees are on a sliding scale from $10 to $15 per day. Scholarships are available and child care is negotiable. Include partial payment $10) when you register. The Womanshare Collective says, "we would like you to come and relax, join in discussion groups and workshops, enjoy good home-cooked food, and get to know us. We feel that being in the country, having a good time with other women can be a very high experience." For more information, write Womanshare, 1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526. Thanks to RUNES for this info.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it calls itself "a feminist country retreat". num_residents is 5 ("a collective of five women who open their house... living with each other in the country"). Land address copied from road mailing address ("1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526"). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ("open their house for workshops to women"), Girl children and Boy children ("child care is negotiable"). Focus: Workshops/education ("open their house for workshops", "join in discussion groups and workshops").

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York
entries.description: A women's country retreat on 10 pasture acres (with access to 90 wooded acres) in the Berkshire mountains in Craryville, NY, with two permanent residents and a women-built A-frame house, offering nightly or monthly rentals, camping, and work exchanges.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT is a place in the country for women to get in touch with our many ways of doing things. It is a special place where women may come together away from the daily hassles of the patriarchal society and experience the strength of a woman's culture. It is not a resort. Each woman who comes to the land makes a commitment to herself and other women thereby accepting responsibility for herself, as well as by respecting and supporting other sisters who are there. Womens Ways is located in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York. There is a large A-frame house built solely by women. There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking. At present there are two permanent residents. As for accomodations, it is possible to rent the A-frame on a nightly ($3.50 - $5) or monthly ($70.00 plus utilities) basis. Camping is available for $2.50 a night or $40.00 a month and access to the house and utilities is available. Work exchanges are also available, as there is never a lack of projects around. Write or call for reservations or information: Women's Ways, Andrews/Mulholland, RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521.- Phone 518 325-6612.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is named "WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT" and offers short-term accommodations and camping to visitors. Acreage is 10 ("There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking"; the 90 acres they only have "access to" is excluded per codebook). num_residents is 2 ("At present there are two permanent residents"). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ("RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521"). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ("a place in the country for women", "where women may come together").

entries.description: A women's collective and retreat on 23 acres in the Adirondacks in Athol, NY, where collective women and their children live in a main house with four nearby cabins and a recreation facility, welcoming all women and groups of up to 30 women on a sliding scale.
entries.raw_text: A WOMAN'S PLACE began in September, 1974 when seven women pooled their resources, purchased a former mountain resort, and established a woman's collective dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women. Women are welcome to come for a day, a week, or a month, and A Woman's Place can also be reserved for groups of up to 30 women. A Woman's Place is situated on 23 acres in the Adirondacks; there is a main house where the collective women and their children live, four large nearby cabins and a recreation facility. The rates are on a sliding scale of $10 to $25 a day. Due to reservation demands, A Woman's Place needs a definite commitment on specific dates. Along with your reservations, please send a small deposit. Write to Mary Deyoe, A Woman's Place, Athol, NY, 12810 - Phone 518 623-9541.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is "dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women". num_residents is left blank because "seven women" is the number of founders in 1974 and the current count of "the collective women and their children" is not stated. Land city, state, and zip copied from mailing address ("Athol, NY, 12810") as the collective lives there. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ("a retreat for all women. Women are welcome"), Girl children and Boy children ("where the collective women and their children live").

entries.land_location_as_stated: with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow
entries.description: 78 acres with trees, hay, animals, and the Elwha River in Port Angeles, WA, owned by the Seattle gay community, where two women live in an 18' tipi and three gay men live in the front houses, welcoming lesbians interested in country living or passing through and hoping to turn the whole property over to lesbians.
entries.raw_text: DEAREST WOMYN: For lesbians who are interested in country living, or passing thru and need a mellow atmosphere to stay in. We live in a 18' tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes. --KD & Barb Aehle - Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angles, WA, 98362 - PH. 206 452-2435
entries.notes: Community name taken from underlined opening salutation "DEAREST WOMYN". Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because the land is collectively owned ("owned by the gay community of Seattle") with 5 residents living there and seeking more lesbians to live there. num_residents is 5: 2 women ("KD & Barb Aehle", "We live in a 18' tipi") plus 3 gay men ("presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses"). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ("Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angles, WA, 98362"; keeping printed spelling "Port Angles"). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Gay men ("The land is for lesbians and faggots").
